items.headline: Wall St futures gain as AI, consulting stocks offset bond-market jitters
items.summary: U.S. stock futures rose as chip and consulting shares benefited from stronger AI-related expectations. Micron’s revenue outlook and $32 billion in customer commitments supported the AI trade, while Nvidia, AMD, and Lam Research gained in premarket trading. Higher Treasury yields and inflation concerns remained a portfolio risk.

items.headline: Jim Cramer warns AI investors about a public-perception problem
items.summary: Jim Cramer warned that worsening public sentiment toward artificial intelligence could affect AI-stock valuations even if the underlying technology continues to work. The report links the concern to industry messaging and investor sensitivity to AI-related risks.
